name: agent-merge-audit
description: Which merges an AI agent wrote, and whether a person approved them: every pull request merged in a period with its agent (Copilot's coding agent, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Jules, Amp and others), its approvals, who merged it, the review rule and the SOC 2 CC8.1 exceptions, as a dated CSV and markdown pair. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/agent-merge-audit locally; no account, no LLM calls of its own. Not audit advice.
